angle_rules.name: Angle Rules
angle_rules.teaches: vertically opposite angles, angles in a triangle (180°), in a quadrilateral (360°), in polygons, and special triangles
angle_rules.representation: a diagram with some angles given; write the missing angle
angle_rules.why: additive_angles stops at angles that share a vertex on a line/point; no skill uses vertically opposite angles or interior angle sums.

area_estimate.name: Estimate Area
area_estimate.teaches: estimating the area of irregular shapes by counting whole and half squares
area_estimate.representation: an irregular blob on squared paper; count whole and part squares; write the estimate
area_estimate.why: Pre-skill for S3: counting whole and part squares is the Y5 skill the triangle counting builds on.

area_triangle_grid.name: Area of Triangles (option)
area_triangle_grid.teaches: the area of a triangle by counting squares, then as half a rectangle for right-angled and any triangles
area_triangle_grid.representation: grid and "half the rectangle" supports on area_triangle
area_triangle_grid.why: area_triangle deals only right-angled triangles by formula; counting squares, the half-rectangle picture and non-right triangles with a dashed perpendicular height are missing.

circles.name: Parts of a Circle
circles.teaches: radius, diameter and circumference; diameter = 2 × radius
circles.representation: a circle with a marked line; write radius or diameter
circles.why: No live skill names radius, diameter or circumference.

draw_accurately.name: Draw Shapes Accurately
draw_accurately.teaches: drawing triangles and quadrilaterals from given lengths and angles with ruler and protractor
draw_accurately.representation: a sketch with measurements; print-first skill with a key drawing
draw_accurately.why: No skill asks pupils to draw a shape from lengths and angles.

draw_angles.name: Draw Angles and Lines
draw_angles.teaches: drawing angles of a given size with a protractor and lines of a given length
draw_angles.representation: a protractor picture with a base line; the key shows the angle drawn; print-first skill
draw_angles.why: Pre-skill: drawing an angle of a given size with a protractor is needed to draw pie-chart sectors and shapes.

dual_bar.name: Dual Bar Charts
dual_bar.teaches: reading and drawing dual bar charts that compare two sets of data
dual_bar.representation: a dual bar chart with a key; answer comparison questions
dual_bar.why: bar_graph shows one data set; no key with two bars per category.

four_quadrants.name: Coordinates in Four Quadrants (option)
four_quadrants.teaches: reading, plotting and solving problems with coordinates in four quadrants (missing vertices, midpoints)
four_quadrants.why: coord_polygon works in the first quadrant on side lengths only; missing vertices and coordinate problems across four quadrants are not dealt.

line_graph.name: Line Graphs
line_graph.teaches: reading and drawing line graphs that show change over time
line_graph.representation: a line graph on a grid with labelled axes; read values, find differences, or plot the points
line_graph.why: No live line graph skill; coordinate_graph plots points but never reads a joined line of data.

mean_missing.name: find a missing value
mean_missing.teaches: Find a Missing Value From the Mean (option)
mean_missing.representation: using the mean x number of items = total to find a missing value, and the mean in a context
mean_missing.family: a boxed list of numbers with one blank box and "mean = 6"; write the total, then the missing number
mean_missing.option: mean only asks for the mean of a list; the WRM step also finds a missing value from a given mean.

net_draw.name: complete or check the net
net_draw.representation: deciding whether a net folds into a cube or cuboid, and completing a net by adding the missing face
net_draw.family: a net on squared paper with one face missing; shade where the face goes, or tick Yes / No for "folds into a cube"
net_draw.option: net_identify only matches a net to its solid (multiple choice); WRM also draws and checks nets.

parallelogram.name: Area of a Parallelogram
parallelogram.teaches: area of a parallelogram as base × perpendicular height, by cutting and moving a triangle
parallelogram.representation: a parallelogram on squared paper with the height dashed; write the area
parallelogram.why: No live skill deals the area of a parallelogram.

pie.name: Pie Charts
pie.teaches: reading pie charts with fractions and percentages and drawing them from angles (360°)
pie.representation: a circle divided into sectors with fraction/percent labels; option: draw from a table
pie.why: pie_chart only reads a printed percent; reading fractions of a whole, amounts from a total, and drawing from angles are missing.

protractor_read.name: Measure With a Protractor (option)
protractor_read.teaches: measuring angles in whole degrees with a protractor: which scale, from 0
protractor_read.option: form "read the protractor": a protractor drawn over the angle; write the degrees (not multiple choice)
protractor_read.why: measure_angles is multiple choice over multiples of 30/45; WRM measures any angle to the nearest degree with a protractor.

reflect_grid.name: Reflect on a Grid
reflect_grid.teaches: reflecting a shape in a horizontal or vertical mirror line on a square grid and in the axes
reflect_grid.representation: a grid with a dashed mirror line and a shape; draw the reflection; key shows it
reflect_grid.why: geo_reflect is multiple choice over the axes; Y6 draws the reflection and writes the new coordinates.

reflex_angles.name: reflex angles
reflex_angles.representation: naming reflex angles (more than 180 degrees) alongside acute, right, obtuse and straight
reflex_angles.family: an angle with the arc drawn on the outside; tick the name from a word bank
reflex_angles.option: identify_angles offers right, acute, obtuse and straight but not reflex, which Y6 classifies.

same_area.name: Same Area, Different Perimeter
same_area.teaches: shapes with the same area but different perimeters, and the reverse
same_area.representation: shapes on squared paper; write area and perimeter for each; circle the pair that match
same_area.why: No skill compares several shapes with equal area and different perimeters (or the reverse); area_perimeter does one rectangle at a time.

translate_grid.name: Translate on a Grid
translate_grid.teaches: translating a shape or point on a first-quadrant grid and describing a translation (3 right, 2 up)
translate_grid.representation: a coordinate grid with a shape and its image; write the translation or draw the image
translate_grid.why: geo_translate is multiple choice; Y6 needs the image drawn in four quadrants and the translation described (and new coordinates written).

vis_mean_levelling.name: The Mean as Levelling
vis_mean_levelling.representation: `support: 'level'` on the mean: objects per person → pooled → equal rows; towers levelled
vis_mean_levelling.why: The WRM lesson introduces the mean as levelling towers; the visual option is already listed.
vis_mean_levelling.teaches: the mean as levelling: pool the objects and share them into equal rows or towers

volume_cubes.name: Volume by Counting Cubes
volume_cubes.teaches: volume as the number of unit cubes (cm³), comparing volumes and estimating volume and capacity
volume_cubes.representation: isometric drawings of cube solids; write how many cubes / cm³; option: which has more
volume_cubes.why: No live skill counts unit cubes in a drawn solid; volume starts at l x w x h.
